quotes.author: Smilingathena
quotes.text: This is my fourth trip out on the Lucky Lady and highly recommend this experience for families, friends, couples or even solo. Captain Tony and his crew are top notch. Trip is six hours and I have caught lots of fish every time out. More sea bass in June, porgies in July. The mates filet your catch and also help with tangles, take fish off the line and providing bait. There is nothing like being out on the open water in the Lucky Lady!

quotes.author: Tishsterrace
quotes.text: Best captain, best crew, best boat! Do not go on any other in Connecticut. Great for families! Matt & Chris make you feel very welcome. You never have to apologize for tangling lines or anything else.

quotes.author: -David S
quotes.text: Awesome experience ! Great Captain and crew. They do all the work for you while you enjoy your day on the boat fishing. Great value for the money. Do not pass this opportunity by.

quotes.author: Nikki C
quotes.text: We had a great time. Mike and Rob were awesome helping us the whole time and finding where the fish were. We caught about 20 keepers! Thanks for a great day!
